columns.description: Number of completed orders on the date.
columns.name: completed_order_count

columns.description: Sum of completed order amounts on the date.
columns.name: completed_revenue

content.description: Completed-order revenue at one row per order date; refunded and cancelled orders are excluded.
content.name: daily_revenue

content.sql:
select
    order_date,
    count(*) as completed_order_count,
    sum(amount) as completed_revenue
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}
where status = 'completed'
group by order_date
